text: The authors model domain-specific Elo as a function of general-intelligence Elo with three phases: a plateau below a minimum general intelligence g1 (task incompetence), a linear increase between g1 and g2 (intelligence payoff), and a plateau above g2 (task saturation), written as a difference of two ReLUs with slope alpha.
title: Double ReLU model: domain Elo vs general Elo with incompetence and saturation plateaus
